subject: OptiCart launch: temporary headroom exception & credit path
messages:
From: Ravi Khanna <ravi.khanna@opticart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@opticart.com
Date: 2027-09-29T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short-term headroom for launch spike

Hi Sean,

We go live with our new checkout AI at 09:30 PT tomorrow and our telemetry shows an expected 9–12x token surge during the first 4 hours. We need a short window increase to avoid throttling — ideally +150k qps for 4 hours and an elevated rate limit for 24 hours. Can Redwood approve a provisional uplift and a one-time overrun credit?

I attached last week's usage to give context (opticart_usage_report_sep29.csv). If we can get a temporary uplift and the overrun credited back to our next invoice, we can proceed without delaying launch.

Ravi
Chief Product Officer
OptiCart Inc
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Khanna <ravi.khanna@opticart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term headroom for launch spike

Ravi — thanks for the heads-up and the attachment. We can provisionally lift headroom for the 4-hour window and place a temporary rate-limit increase for 24 hours, pending internal sign-off from finance and legal.

Proposed path:
- Redwood will enable a provisional +150k qps for the 4-hour launch window and a 24-hour throttle ceiling at +50k qps afterwards.
- We'll hold the billing for any incremental token consumption in escrow while legal reviews the amendment.
- If we agree post-launch on the usage reconciliation and the one-time credit, we'll apply it as a bill credit on the next invoice.

I looped in Marissa for pricing and Laura for legal/contract amendment. Can you confirm exact UTC times for the 4-hour window and share the traffic pattern (burst start/end)?

—Sean
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term headroom for launch spike

Team — quick pricing note. For provisional headroom we recommend:
- Apply provisional uplift at list rate but mark incremental usage as "provisional" for reconciliation.
- Offer a one-time discretionary credit equal to the overrun amount up to $18k (to cover customer goodwill) contingent on launch verification and no repeated over-usage in next 30 days.
- If usage exceeds the provisional uplift by >20%, we keep standard overrun billing (no credit).

This protects Redwood margin while allowing OptiCart to launch. Ben — can finance place the provisional uplift on an invoice-hold/escrow so it doesn't auto-bill?

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ravi Khanna <ravi.khanna@opticart.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OptiCart launch: temporary headroom exception & credit path

Ravi / Sean — legal reviewed and drafted a provisional amendment for a short-term uplift and credit pathway. Key points:
- Amendment authorizes a one-off provisional capacity increase for specified UTC start/end times.
- All provisional usage will be recorded and reconciled; any credit is discretionary and granted after verification of reported traffic and anomaly checks.
- OptiCart must sign the amendment prior to the uplift being applied.

I've attached a draft (provisional-amendment-draft.docx). Ravi — can your contracts team sign a PDF copy today? If so, operations can schedule the change immediately after signature.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ravi Khanna <ravi.khanna@opticart.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OptiCart launch: temporary headroom exception & credit path

Ravi — thanks for the quick signature (signed-amendment-opticart.pdf received). Operations has scheduled the +150k qps window for 2027-10-02T16:00:00Z–2027-10-02T20:00:00Z (four hours). The 24-hour elevated ceiling will remain until 2027-10-03T20:00:00Z.

Billing note: we placed the provisional uplift on invoice hold; we'll collect usage metrics and reconcile within 7 business days. Based on the reconciliation policy in the amendment, we're prepared to grant a discretionary credit up to $18,000 if the post-launch review confirms normal launch behavior and no abuse.

Attachments: opticart_usage_report_sep29.csv, signed-amendment-opticart.pdf

Ben Carter
Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
